title: An artifact outside the project cannot be recorded by its fingerprint (#14 item 3)
symptom: evidence add --artifact with an absolute path outside the project is refused
trigger: Run evidence add --artifact <absolute path outside the project> on Chough 0.5.0
expected: The file is fingerprinted in place, its path kept only in .chough/local/external-artifacts.toml, and the entry holds only external: ext-<hex> and its fingerprint (REQ-records-005)
actual: The path is refused ('artifact path must be spelled canonically')
impact: Proof that lives outside the repository, such as a large capture, cannot be recorded at all
source: GitHub issue #14 item 3, red on 0.5.0 by t38b at 69b56154 (leif/0.6.0-records-red)

notes.text: Added despite similar reports: A separate issue (#14 item 3): recording an outside artifact by fingerprint, not where a case run's log goes; one test covers both

status: open -> verified. Green on integration after t37j's 45cc9853 and ad496d21: TC-records-proof-split-and-external passes (local logs with the command and the output's SHA-256, key failing lines, and an outside artifact fingerprinted in place under ext-<hex>).
